reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random and saved her correction to the brain: the Tamsin Cold Chain signed order form is due 24 September, not 20 November 2026. Her post in #north-team this morning had said 20 November 2026.

Two things I pointed out to her:
- **The date may be wrong:** today is 14 October 2026, so if she means 24 September this year, that deadline has already passed. I asked her to confirm the date, or the year if she meant a different one.
- **The old post is still up:** her original message in #north-team still says 20 November, so Dana and Marcus will see that date unless she fixes it there.

The brain may still hold the 20 November date from her morning post as a separate fact. I tried to remove it but couldn't find it by ID, so the correction sits alongside it as the newer fact.
